methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $2M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
1X Technologies is a Pre-Seed stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $1.1B to date. The comparable universe consists of 9 peers across robotics and manufacturing—1 public (277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers to support a reliable peer-median approach; only 1 adjacent-stage peer was identified against a minimum threshold of 3.

Given data constraints, the Stage-Progression method is applicable. Using total raised ($1.1B) normalized to a $2M base proxy and applying a standard Pre-Seed-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $5M. This single-method triangulation constrains the analysis to a relatively narrow band.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $4M (low) to $6M (high), with a median of $5M. Key uncertainties center on the applicability of the 2.5x step-up multiplier given 1X's already-substantial capital raise relative to typical Pre-Seed cohorts, and the absence of narrowly-comparable peers to validate stage-progression assumptions. A fuller peer-based triangulation would require identifying additional Pre-Seed or Seed robotics companies at comparable funding levels.
